purpose: Verified NASA/JPL Mars Trek WMTS layer metadata for frontend map integration (observed, not assumed)

tile_matrix_set.matrix_at_level_z: 2^(z+1) columns x 2^z rows; each tile spans 180 / 2^z degrees
tile_matrix_set.scale_denominator_note: Published ScaleDenominators assume 0.28 mm pixels and ~111 km per degree (Earth); derive Mars ground size from degrees with R = 3 396 190 m instead.
tile_matrix_set.row_and_column: TileRow counts down from 90 N, TileCol counts east from 180 W (same as Leaflet {y}/{x} with an equirectangular CRS of 2x1 tiles at zoom 0)

layers.title: MRO HiRISE, Jezero Mosaic, Controlled
layers.format: image/png (2 bands: grey + alpha; alpha 0 = no data)

layers.title: MGS MOLA color hillshade (global, 463 m)
layers.note: Regional context only: 463 m pixels cannot show the metre-scale hazards used for routing.

capabilities_quirk: The ResourceURL templates contain a double slash ('1.0.0//{Style}'); requests with a single slash were served normally (HTTP 200).
